name: codearts-actions-plugin-setupjdk
description: CodeArts Actions 插件 - 初始化 JDK 环境

scripts.package-main: ncc build src/main.ts -o dist && shx mv dist/index.js dist/main.js
scripts.package-stop: ncc build src/stop.ts -o dist && shx mv dist/index.js dist/stop.js
scripts.compile: npm run build && npm run package-main && npm run package-stop
scripts.zip: rimraf dist/src && rimraf  dist/tests && node scripts/package-zip.js
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run zip

author: edward
